fishing: WHEN: Wed Oct 21 post-front NE winds easing, better later. PASSES-BEACH: limited by recent wind/king tides; some redfish near passes on live shrimp. LEMON BAY: hit-or-miss back bay redfish, small snook, snappers around mangroves/docks. NEARSHORE: few windows due to weather, mangrove snapper when possible. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, gold spoons.
redtide: FWC Oct 16: K. brevis at background concentrations in 6 samples from/offshore SWFL (Sarasota in/offshore, Hillsborough offshore). Not present Charlotte/Lee/Collier. No fish kills or respiratory irritation past week.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~10 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches, sample ~Oct 5). No advisory. Manasota Key similar good.
fpl: Charlotte ~3 outages, Sarasota ~29 outages (FPL tracker); small isolated only, no major Englewood/Manasota impact.

eatPick.name: Lock 'N Key Restaurant
eatPick.why: Wednesday rotation from beach tiki to local Beach Road favorite. Nearly 4,000 reviews at 4.5, open till 10p with solid seafood and casual American fare close to Manasota Key.
